description: This source file implements a DualCache class that maintains cache entries in both Redis and an in-memory cache, providing methods for setting, getting, incrementing, batch operations, and cache management functions. It specifically distinguishes itself through its dual caching strategy, including batch and async methods, and a custom LimitedSizeOrderedDict for size-limited cache management.

classes.name: LimitedSizeOrderedDict
classes.description: A subclass of OrderedDict with a maximum size limit that automatically removes the oldest item upon exceeding the size.

classes.name: DualCache
classes.description: A cache implementation that updates both Redis and an in-memory cache simultaneously with methods supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations, batch updates, TTL management, and cache invalidation.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Sets a cache value in both in-memory and Redis caches unless restricted by local_only.

methods.name: int increment_cache( self, key, value: int, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Increments an integer cache value in both caches and returns the new value.

methods.name: get_cache( self, key, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Retrieves a cache value, first from in-memory, then from Redis if not found, updating in-memory cache if fetched from Redis.

methods.name: batch_get_cache( self, keys: list, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Retrieves multiple cache values with support for running within existing event loops or in a new thread.

methods.name: async_get_cache( self, key, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches a cache value with in-memory and Redis fallback, updating in-memory cache if fetched from Redis.

methods.name: List[str] get_redis_batch_keys( self, current_time: float, keys: List[str], result: List[Any], )
methods.description: Identifies which keys need to be fetched from Redis based on expiry and last access times.

methods.name: async_batch_get_cache( self, keys: list, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves multiple cache entries, utilizing in-memory cache and conditional Redis fetch to optimize performance.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs)
methods.description: Asynchronously sets a cache value in both caches.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline( self, cache_list: list, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Batch asynchronously updates multiple cache entries.

methods.name: float async_increment_cache( self, key, value: float, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronously increments a numeric cache value in both caches.

methods.name: Optional[List[float]] async_increment_cache_pipeline( self, increment_list: List["RedisPipelineIncrementOperation"], local_only: bool = False, parent_otel_span: Optional[Span] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Batch asynchronously increments multiple cache values.

methods.name: None async_set_cache_sadd( self, key, value: List, local_only: bool = False, **kwargs )
methods.description: Adds values to a set in both caches asynchronously.

methods.description: Clears all entries from both in-memory and Redis caches.

methods.description: Deletes a key from both caches.
